prompts.text: Take your time today. You have already made meaningful progress, and the next step does not need to be perfect.
I still smile when I remember our long conversations, the familiar jokes, and the way an ordinary afternoon could feel special.
Did you remember to pause, breathe, and notice how far you have come? I hope you did.
Bright blue birds drift past the quiet garden while soft rain brushes the windows and children laugh nearby.
Meet me at seven thirty on October twelfth, and bring three photographs, two letters, and one favorite story.
When a difficult day feels larger than you expected, remember that you can move slowly, ask for help, and begin again tomorrow with patience and courage.
